photos.quoteMd: Time and time again we’ve seen businesses shutter in my district and throughout the city due to rent increases. This bill helps establish basic rights for commercial tenants so the businesses that are a vital part of our communities can continue to serve our communities and thrive.
photos.quoteSm: This bill establishes rights for commercial tenants, so small businesses in our communities can serve and thrive.

photos.quoteMd: We see thriving community spaces shuttered overnight due to doubling and tripling rents. Commercial tenants invest in our neighborhoods, provide work and services, and reflect our culture. Commercial rent stabilization is an important step toward achieving an equitable, diverse, and just city.
photos.quoteSm: We see thriving community spaces shuttered overnight due to doubling and tripling rents.

photos.quoteMd: When you give small businesses a fighting chance, you give whole neighborhoods a fighting chance
photos.quoteSm: When you give small businesses a fighting chance, you give whole neighborhoods a fighting chance.

photos.quoteMd: Losing the independently-owned small businesses that we love, one after another, tears at the fabric of our communities. If we want to preserve what is best about our communities, amidst skyrocketing rents we must take bold action now.
photos.quoteSm: Losing independently-owned small businesses we love, tears at the fabric of communities. We must take bold action now.

photos.quoteMd: As commercial rents go up, venues are driven out of business, destroying opportunities for musicians.
photos.quoteSm: As commercial rents go up, venues are driven out of business, destroying opportunities for indie musicians.

photos.quoteMd: Street vendors are the smallest businesses in NYC. And they’re an essential component of our neighborhoods. The Commercial Rent Stabilization bill is the first step needed in protecting our small businesses.
photos.quoteSm: Street vendors are the smallest businesses. Commercial Rent Stabilization is the first step in protecting all our small businesses.

photos.quoteMd: We’re here to support Commercial Rent Stabilization because landlords like ours should not be able to abuse the power against small businesses like ours.
photos.quoteSm: We support commercial rent stabilization. Landlords should not abuse power against small businesses like ours.

photos.quoteMd: My two stores did not close because of Amazon - my business was thriving. It was because of unreasonable rent.
photos.quoteSm: My two stores did not close because of Amazon - my business was thriving. It was because of unreasonable rent.
